physical_coordinate: probe_vertical_position in microns; available for every V1 unit
ccf_sensitivity: first 3D CCF principal component where available
decomposition: leave-one-cell-out Gaussian smoothing of covariance trace over probe vertical position; bandwidth selected per session from 40-400 um by cross-fitted MSE
physical_split: six nonoverlapping shank-position blocks; alternating blocks assigned to target halves
null: residual trace permuted within shank blocks while RF centers, block membership, and shank-predicted component remain fixed
